ai.why_it_matters: It suggests that a marked decline in this selenium-related protein with age may be a signal worth noting for long-term metabolic health.
ai.life_skill: Notice and discuss any unexplained rapid health changes with a qualified professional rather than assuming they are normal ageing.

ai.headline: AI agents can learn multi-step tasks better by using their own attention to reward earlier steps.

items.title: The impact of temporal resampling on the safety of clinical reinforcement learning: A simulated trial

ai.headline: Regularising irregular medical timings can make AI treatment models perform worse and look safer than they are.
ai.summary: The study looked at how AI models for healthcare are trained using patient records with irregular timings. Standard safety checks on resampled data falsely predicted much better results than the models actually achieved.
ai.why_it_matters: It shows that common data processing can hide risks in AI healthcare tools before they reach real patients.
ai.life_skill: Check whether health AI tools were trained on real, unedited timing of decisions rather than artificially regular schedules.

ai.caveat: The findings come from a simulated trial using virtual patients, not real people, so they do not prove what would happen in actual clinical care.
